title: Fast and Furious: Real Time End-to-End 3D Detection, Tracking and Motion Forecasting with a Single Convolutional Net

problem.summary: Modern approaches to self-driving divide the problem into four steps: detection, object tracking, motion forecasting and motion planning. This can result in catastrophic failures as downstream processes cannot recover from errors that appear at the beginning of the pipeline.

In contrast, in this paper we propose an end-to-end fully convolutional approach that performs simultaneous 3D detection, tracking and motion forecasting by exploiting spatio-temporal information captured by a 3D sensor.

Different from all the above work, in this paper we propose a single network that takes advantage of temporal information and tackles the problem of 3D detection, short term motion forecasting and tracking in the scenario of autonomous driving.
